data.exact_reserve_text: The 2012 year of account ran off on a satisfactory basis as longstanding reserves continued their trend of steady release as remaining open items were either identified as redundant or finally settled as a result of negotiation or litigation.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a release of GBP 2.6m in prior year reserves, specifically from the 2012 year of account. This favorable development was attributed to longstanding reserves running off satisfactorily, with open items being identified as redundant or settled through negotiation or litigation.
raw_causal_phrases: longstanding reserves continued their trend of steady release
remaining open items were either identified as redundant or finally settled as a result of negotiation or litigation

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount is derived from the 'Underwriting profit' of the 2012 year of account, which was closed in 2014. This is considered a gross figure as it's part of the underwriting result before other income/expenses.
